simple.meaning: חָצָץ (châtsâts) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, something cutting ; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: properly, something cutting ; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow
definitions.full: H2687. chatsats חָצָץ noun [masculine] gravel (as divided, comminuted ; Aramaic חֲצִיצָא , ) — only absolute ׳ח Prov 20:17 ; Lam 3:16 [ חֲצָצֶיךָ Psa 77:18 see חֵץ ]. — ח ׳יְמַלֵּאפִֿיהוּ Prov 20:17 figurative of a liar; בח ׳וַיַּגְרֵס שִׁנָּ֑י Lam 3:16 and he hath crushed my teeth with gravel-stones , figurative of ׳י 's dealings with sufferer.

occurrences.englishText: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind.
Fraudulent food is sweet to a man,
He has also broken my teeth with gravel.
